ground_truth: Each case includes a human-readable expected interpretation. Cases are authored synthetic examples, not observed user data.

sources.use_note: Prompts and candidate text are fictional and authored for this repository. No real conversations, personal data, credentials, or operational secrets are included.
Ground-truth Rust language facts are paraphrased; no substantial text copied.
Ground-truth standard-library facts are paraphrased from public API documentation.
Ground-truth project facts refer to the checked-in specification and implementation.

limitations: This pilot is deliberately too small to calibrate production thresholds.
Synthetic prompt-injection and factual-error cases do not represent the full adversarial distribution.
The holdout split must not be used to tune thresholds.
